pair.email_hint: Enter the email address of a NOTTY Smart Pet account (the app you use to control your Revoloo). NOTTY will email you a login code.
pair.code_hint: Check your email for the code from NOTTY.
pair.code_required: Enter the code from the email
pair.one_login_title: NOTTY allows one login per account
pair.one_login_tip: Logging in here logs that account out of the NOTTY app. Tip: in the NOTTY app, share your litter box with a second account (another email address) and log in with that one here. Then you stay logged in on your phone.
pair.session_expired: Your NOTTY login has ended, probably because you logged in elsewhere with the same account. Please log in again.

device.offline: The litter box is offline according to the NOTTY cloud
device.login_expired: NOTTY login expired. Use 'Repair' on this device to log in again.
device.cat_not_found: This cat was not found in your NOTTY account
